verdict.rationale: First-party docs say stablecoin payments settle as fiat in the merchant's Stripe balance in local currency. That makes the settlement destination and currency legible for accounting. However, none of the three specific elements the story asks for are evidenced in the pack: no documented payment-to-available-balance timing, no published per-rail fees, and no statements or reports. missing for 10: documented settlement timing to available balance, published fee schedule per network/stablecoin rail, accounting-consumable statements/reports, independent corroboration.
